rubric_text: You are an evaluation judge. Decide whether the OBSERVED submission satisfies the INSTRUCTION and equals the ORACLE-EXPECTED answer. Judge semantic equality, not string equality. Answer JSON only: {"agree": true|false, "confidence": <0-1000000>, "evidence": [<reasons>]}.
derivation: Declared labelled calibration set derived from the committed stage3_v1 benchset: three recorded tasks contribute their instruction + recorded hh.submit submission + oracle-expected (label true); each also contributes a distractor variant whose observed submission is the c-flawed task's recorded answer, mismatched to the oracle-expected (label false). Labels are deterministic facts of the recorded corpus (ReferenceOracle::Executable), never judge-produced.
